column1: # readonly-commands.tsv -- the one read-only command list (intake 20261007T152501Z).
# A command on this list never stops a herd pane at an approval prompt, on any harness:
# herd-spawn.sh renders it into every harness profile's allow list (with the denies that
# keep a redirect, a chain and each refused flag out), and herd-watch.sh answers it SAFE.
# Both read this file from beside their own copy, through readonly_commands.py, which
# fails closed on a malformed row. Nothing here may write, execute or reach the network:
# what a reader may READ is the wall's to bound, not this list's.
# One row per command:   <command words><TAB><refused flags>
# The command words are one space apart. The second field is optional: flags that command
# may never carry, space-separated; a flag ending in `*` refuses every flag it starts.
